workrb.resume_shape: Checkpoint-derived pending (task,dataset) work is skipped on resume and an all-complete checkpoint returns without evaluation.
workrb.crash_order: For each pending dataset, task.evaluate(...) runs before _record_dataset_result(...), which then saves the checkpoint.
workrb.assessment: Useful missing-dataset resume, but still exposes a provider/model-completed -> local-checkpoint-missing uncertainty window; it is not a pre-dispatch evaluation WAL.

reference_implementation.provider_model: Separate SQLite-backed deterministic provider simulator keyed by stable content-bound cell_id, with explicit reconcile and execute calls.
reference_implementation.scope_limit: This proves the controller state-machine ordering and crash-recovery invariants only for the deterministic local provider simulator. It does not establish exactly-once execution for arbitrary real remote providers; a real provider needs durable idempotency semantics or UNKNOWN/reconciliation that can authoritatively determine prior acceptance.

minimal_authority_chain: commit content-bound OuterEvaluationIntent before any remote dispatch
derive stable per-cell IDs and persist planned cells
on every restart reconcile a non-completed cell before any execute
execute only if prior remote effect is authoritatively absent or provider idempotency makes replay the same logical effect
commit immutable cell outcome bound to request digest
derive completed/missing partition from cell log and execute only missing cells
derive certificate from exact immutable cell outcome digests
commit certificate then terminal seal without evaluator access on recovery
on later certify, check SEALED/certificate before any provider/evaluator access and return cache-only
deny OUTER access through generic evaluation APIs

post_freeze_control_observation.handling: Observed by SHA-only ref lookup after substantive work. Newer control semantics were not read or adopted; semantic exploration stopped and only frozen-tuple durability writes continued.
